column2: Volt set the scooter's clock right before this test, so the scooter may not be keeping the time it's given. Until that's solved, a smart plug is a safer timer. Report an issue with diagnostics so we can look into it.
column3: Volt puso en hora el reloj del patinete justo antes de esta prueba, así que es posible que el patinete no conserve la hora que recibe. Hasta que se resuelva, un enchufe inteligente es un temporizador más seguro. Usa «Informar de un problema» con diagnósticos para que podamos revisarlo.
column4: Volt set the scooter's clock to the correct time just before this test, so it is possible that the scooter does not keep the time it receives. Until this is resolved, a smart plug is a safer timer. Use "Report a problem" with diagnostics so that we can review it.
